seoTitle: Free Domain Expiry Date Tracker for a List of Domains
metaDescription: Paste domains with expiry dates and see days left, sorted, with renewal warnings. Free, offline, no lookups.
intro: Takes a list of domains and expiry dates you already have and sorts them by days left, marking expired domains and those that need renewing soon.
why:
Missed renewals cost money and sometimes the domain. A spreadsheet works, but you need the date maths and the sorting every time you look.

This tool does only that part. It does not look dates up, because a web page cannot query registries without a server. Copy the dates from your registrar or from the WHOIS and RDAP tools and check them again before you rely on them.
howTo: Write one domain and date per line, for example example.com, 2030-08-13.
Set the warning threshold in days.

faq.q: Does it look up expiry dates?
faq.a: No. It only calculates from the dates you enter.
YYYY-MM-DD, optionally followed by a time. Anything else is reported as an error.
Dates are treated as UTC days.
No. It runs once in your browser and stores nothing.
